patterns.note: Alternating full-width sections with either centered content or a two-column split layout (text on left, product mockup/image on right).
Strategic use of a vibrant green as a primary accent for CTAs, checkmarks, and key highlights against a largely neutral palette of white, light grey, and dark text.
Clear typographic hierarchy with large, bold sans-serif headings for sections and sub-sections, supported by readable body text and smaller, often uppercase, labels.
The primary navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
Sections are visually separated by alternating background colors (white, light green, light grey) to delineate different content blocks.

technique_notes: The main navigation bar is fixed to the top of the viewport, maintaining visibility as the user scrolls. It appears to gain a subtle shadow or border to distinguish it from the content below once scrolling begins.

Content sections are built with full-width containers, using a combination of centered content blocks and two-column grids. The two-column layouts typically feature descriptive text on one side and a relevant product screenshot or illustration on the other.
Visual separation between sections is achieved by varying the background color, cycling between white, a soft pastel green, and a very light grey to create distinct content areas.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are significantly larger and bolder than body text, with a clear hierarchy from hero to section titles, using a consistent sans-serif typeface.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners are applied to buttons, input fields, and card-like elements, providing a soft, approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced and generous padding around sections and within content blocks creates an airy feel, preventing visual clutter while maintaining content density.

standout: The site's design stands out through its confident and consistent use of a vibrant, yet not overwhelming, green as a primary accent color. This, combined with clean, structured layouts and clear product mockups, creates a highly professional and trustworthy impression that is both functional and visually appealing.
